records.title: Identity headers are honoured only from AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES; never from loopback or the container's own addresses
records.body: {"why": "phase 13 audit: loopback and private ranges were implicitly trusted, so source-host extension code, Docker peers or LAN clients could send Remote-User and become owner", "effect": "owners using Authelia/external sign-in must set AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES at the 0.5.0 deploy; the app shows a notice, the wizard requires it"}

records.title: The source host runs as the app user (568) inside a Landlock sandbox; a separate uid is optional and not recommended
records.body: {"why": "a uid switch needs CAP_SETUID, which the image drops (cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges); Landlock needs no capability", "limits": "network is open (it can reach the app's HTTP port; identity headers are refused from loopback); /dev/shm shared"}
